ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُۙ
ayahs.translation: O you the (sleeping) enwrapped one!

ayahs.arabicText: قُمِ الَّیْلَ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Stand up in Prayer by night, all but a small part of it;

ayahs.arabicText: نِّصْفَهٗۤ اَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِیْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: half of it, or reduce it a little;

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ زِدْ عَلَیْهِ وَ رَتِّلِ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَرْتِیْلًاؕ
ayahs.translation: or add to it a little; and recite the Qur'an slowly and distinctly.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا سَنُلْقِیْ عَلَیْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Behold, We shall cast upon you a Weighty Word.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ الَّیْلِ هِیَ اَشَدُّ وَطْاً وَّ اَقْوَمُ قِیْلًاؕ
ayahs.translation: Surely getting up at night is the best means of subduing the self and is more suitable for uprightness in speech.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ لَكَ فِی النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِیْلًاؕ
ayahs.translation: You are indeed much occupied during the day with the affairs of the world.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَ تَبَتَّلْ اِلَیْهِ تَبْتِیْلًاؕ
ayahs.translation: So remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He. So take Him alone for your Guardian,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ اهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: And bear patiently the vain things they utter, and gracefully forsake them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ذَرْنِیْ وَ الْمُكَذِّبِیْنَ اُولِی النَّعْمَةِ وَ مَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Leave it to Me to deal with the affluent ones who give the lie (to the Truth), and bear with them for a while.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ لَدَیْنَاۤ اَنْكَالًا وَّ جَحِیْمًاۙ
ayahs.translation: We have heavy fetters and a blazing Fire in store for them;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ طَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَّ عَذَابًا اَلِیْمًاۗ
ayahs.translation: and a food that chokes, and a grievous chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْاَرْضُ وَ الْجِبَالُ وَ كَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِیْبًا مَّهِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: (They will come across all this) on the Day when the earth and the mountains shall tremble violently and the mountains shall crumble into heaps of scattered sand.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَاۤ اِلَیْكُمْ رَسُوْلًا١ۙ۬ شَاهِدًا عَلَیْكُمْ كَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَاۤ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُوْلًاؕ
ayahs.translation: Surely We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness over you, just as We had sent a Messenger to Pharaoh.

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَصٰى فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُوْلَ فَاَخَذْنٰهُ اَخْذًا وَّبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed Our Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَیْفَ تَتَّقُوْنَ اِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ یَوْمًا یَّجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِیْبَاۗۖ
ayahs.translation: If you persist in disbelieving, how will you guard yourself against the (woe of the) Day that will turn children grey-haired,

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لسَّمَآءُ مُنْفَطِرٌۢ بِهٖ١ؕ كَانَ وَعْدُهٗ مَفْعُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: the Day whose severity shall cause the heaven to split asunder? Allah's promise is ever bound to be fulfilled.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌ١ۚ فَمَنْ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Indeed this is nothing but a Good Counsel; so let him who will take a way leading to his Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ یَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ تَقُوْمُ اَدْنٰى مِنْ ثُلُثَیِ الَّیْلِ وَ نِصْفَهٗ وَ ثُلُثَهٗ وَ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِیْنَ مَعَكَ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ یُقَدِّرُ الَّیْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ١ؕ عَلِمَ اَنْ لَّنْ تُحْصُوْهُ فَتَابَ عَلَیْكُمْ فَاقْرَءُوْا مَا تَیَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِ١ؕ عَلِمَ اَنْ سَیَكُوْنُ مِنْكُمْ مَّرْضٰى١ۙ وَ اٰخَرُوْنَ یَضْرِبُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ یَبْتَغُوْنَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللّٰهِ١ۙ وَ اٰخَرُوْنَ یُقَاتِلُوْنَ فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ١ۖ٘ فَاقْرَءُوْا مَا تَیَسَّرَ مِنْهُ١ۙ وَ اَقِیْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَ اَقْرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا١ؕ وَ مَا تُقَدِّمُوْا لِاَنْفُسِكُمْ مِّنْ خَیْرٍ تَجِدُوْهُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَیْرًا وَّ اَعْظَمَ اَجْرًا١ؕ وَ اسْتَغْفِرُوا اللّٰهَ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِیْمٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), your Lord knows that you sometimes stand up in Prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, and sometimes half or one-third of it, and so does a party of those with you; Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He has shown mercy to you. So now recite as much of the Qur'an as you can. He knows that there are among you those who are sick and others who are journeying in the land in quest of Allah's bounty, and still others who are fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite as much of the Qur'an as you easily can, and establish Prayer, and pay Zakah, and give Allah a goodly loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you shall find it with Allah. That is better and its reward is greater. And ask for Allah's forgiveness; surely He is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
